title: Induction Intake Prompts
description: Prompt text and suggestion-chip content for the induction terminal's Pages 7-8 (design/induction-terminal.md, revised by design/induction-intake-audit.md §6 on 2026-09-18). Page 7 holds the Personal File short fields and the Personality one-liners; Page 8 holds the five open questions and the freeform box. Every prompt declares a `bioPath` -- the real sf2e Actor path its answer is written to on confirm -- so no answer this form collects is ever left unrecorded. Every suggestion is illustrative only, offered as a quick-start a player may click to insert into their own free-text answer, never a real answer for any of the six actual kids (data/characters/kids/README.md). Singleton file: data/campaign/induction-intake-prompts.json.

genderIdentityOptions.description: Suggestion chips for Page 7's gender-identity field. Illustrative only -- the field is always free text too, and this list is deliberately not exhaustive.

pronounOptions.description: Suggestion chips for Page 7's pronouns field. Same free-text-always-available rule as genderIdentityOptions.

appearanceOptions.description: Suggestion chips for Page 7's appearance-notes field -- generic texture, not a real description of any of the six actual kids.

personalFile.description: Page 7's short factual fields (age, height, weight, birthplace). One line each, never an essay prompt -- the deliberate answer to filling sf2e's biography fields without adding open questions (audit §6c).

personality.description: Page 7's Personality one-liners, mapping onto sf2e's own Personality block (likes/dislikes/attitude/beliefs). Carries two survivors of the 2026-09-18 compression: `likes` is bible §20's old Q5 (the smallest good day) and `good-at` is its old Q2, both demoted from open questions to single lines rather than cut.

openQuestions.description: Page 8's open questions -- deliberately capped small. Eleven open questions (three banal + bible §20's eight) were compressed to five here on 2026-09-18; raising this count back up is a design decision, not a content edit, and should go through design/induction-intake-audit.md first.

freeform.description: The single large catch-all box -- ideas/entries/character-creation-intake-form.json's original 'write as much or as little as you want' prompt, finally built. Writes to sf2e's own Backstory field.

id.description: Kebab-case; also the state key and the DOM element id suffix.

text.description: The prompt itself, as the player reads it.

bioPath.description: The real sf2e Actor path this answer is written to on confirm (e.g. system.details.biography.likes), verified against gamesystems/sf2e/template.json. Several prompts MAY share one path -- core/induction-bio.mjs joins them into one headed block, which is how campaignNotes carries more than one answer. Null means deliberately intake-only, which should be rare and justified.

outOfCharacter.description: True for a prompt addressed to the PLAYER rather than the character. Affects how the answer is headed on the sheet and how the form frames it.

purposeNote.description: OOC framing for what this answer is used for, shown behind the per-question help toggle. Null where the prompt genuinely needs no explanation -- never invented to make every entry look equally annotated.

suggestions.description: Illustrative answer chips. Clicking one inserts it into the free-text field; never binding, a player's own words always win. Deliberately empty for the freeform box, which is the player's alone.
